directory_create.description: Create a directory tree only inside the configured controller-local workspace. Existing directories succeed without change, while files or symlink components are refused. No command execution, remote host selection, privilege escalation or overwrite. Linux only.

path.description: Directory path in the configured local controller workspace. Remote paths are refused.

file_move.description: Move one regular file between two configured controller-local workspace paths. Never overwrite an existing destination or follow source/parent symlinks. Requires an existing destination parent and same-device atomic rename support; no copy/delete fallback. This removes the old filename but retains the file inode. Linux only.

destination.description: Absent destination path with an existing non-symlink parent directory.

source.description: Existing local ordinary file to move, never a symlink or directory.
